name: A Dark Room
tagline: The fire lives in the file. Close the tab — still stoking. Invite someone to the same fire.
description:
Close it mid-stoke and open it: the fire, the wood, the village are still there, inside this copy of the app. Send the Invite in the bar and a friend sits at the same fire — they can stoke, gather, and build while you keep the room going.

You wake in a dark room. Light the fire. Stoke it. A stranger arrives who can build. The village grows, the path opens, the world is a map of letters, and then there is a ship.

The original sent phones to an app-store splash. This copy plays on a phone: the buttons are thumb-sized, the log sits above the room, and a pad under the map walks the wanderer. Sound is packed in — nothing is fetched. Lights start off.

An unofficial port of A Dark Room by Michael Townsend and doublespeak games.
